summary: Instagram losing followers despite daily posting; reels lose 64% viewers in first 3 seconds — hook failure is the single weakest area. Bio violates rules: niche/region targeting, timeframe claim, free offer phrasing. LinkedIn and Bluesky too small for signal.
guidance:
- Hook: rotate question, contrast, comparison styles; kill the DIY-vs-pro comparison (used 4× recently).
- Format: images outperform reels 6×; use silhouette or desk-glow static visuals.
- Content: show developer's real work (code, config, wireframes), never ad copy.
- Service focus: lead_gen and chatbot earn more per reach; website is median.
- Bio must be fixed: remove niches, region, '24 hrs', and 'free check' phrasing.

instructions.research: Find 3 real Indian small-business websites (hotel, clinic, D2C) with missing FAQ/schema/mobile issues; note exact URL patterns for writer to reference generically.
instructions.analysis: Compare last 4 website posts: all used question/contrast hooks; none used comparison or myth_bust. Next hook must be comparison or myth_bust.
instructions.writer: Write one Instagram carousel (3-4 slides) using myth_bust hook: 'Myth: a website is just an online brochure. Reality: it's an automated FAQ engine.' Show generic code snippet or CMS config screenshot (no client data). End with 'Pay after approval' + DM CTA.
instructions.image: Create 3-slide carousel: slide 1 myth text on silhouette desk-glow background; slide 2 blurred code/config close-up; slide 3 'Pay after approval • DM for honest advice' on clean background. No logos, no client names.
instructions.video: Skip reel today. If video needed later, script first 3 seconds as a visual question (text on screen) with zero talking-head intro.

manual_tips: Update Instagram bio to: 'Websites for small businesses across India. Pay after approval. DM for honest advice.' (removes niches, region, timeframe, free-offer wording)
Comment thoughtfully on 5 posts by Indian freelancers/agencies discussing client acquisition or website challenges — no self-promo, just perspective.
Reply to any story mentions or tags from the last 7 days with a genuine question about their workflow.
